descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S18 「设备日期错（3.8），seed 出来的：两次来自时钟正确设备的写入之间，一台快一天的手机录了一行」 Wrong device date (3.8), seeded: a phone one day ahead records a line between two writes from a correct device

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. …（UAT 3.8）
  • U11 Nothing invented or doubled: the list holds only lines that were recorded or dictated, with no added line (e.g. 'Encounter completed.') and no line listed twice.（UAT 3.4）
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is.（TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given {hospitalPatient}. Device A (correct clock) writes transcriptDate today [A1, A2]. Device B, clock one day ahead, opens the chart (its live transcript starts empty because the stored date is not its today) and writes tomorrow's toDateString [B1]. Device A, still mounted, writes today's date [A1, A2, A3]. …

When Open the Encounter tab on a correctly-clocked browser and look at Prior Encounter Transcripts; open 'Most Recent'

Then Per 3.8, one session holds A1, A2, A3 and B1, each listed once; there is no '(prior)' row and no row dated tomorrow

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8 ('shows the same state as any other device'; 'Test with one device set to the wrong date'). cp1 (collapsed): mustContain 'Most Recent'; mustNotContain '(prior)', '{Mon D, tomorrow}'. cp2 (Most Recent open): mustContain QA16-CLK-B1 (A1-A3 are also in Recorded Transcript, so only B1 is evidence). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
